note: The Start-here tracks on the home page, and the tier of each page a track stages. A track is a short, ordered list of theme slugs (a theme slug is a learning-paths.json profile id), listed from the gentlest theme to the hardest, read by site/src/components/StartHere through site/src/lib/tracks.ts. A tier is one of intro, core or advanced and says where a page sits on the way in; it lives here, never in a page's frontmatter. Every theme a track lists must have a tier; any other published slug may have one. The tracks gate (make gate G=check-tracks) holds the tracks to published, non-draft theme pages and the tiers to the legal values. Edited by hand.
